entities.name: Detlef Kästner
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Detlef Kästner is a retired boxer, who represented East Germany at the 1980 Summer Olympics in Moscow, Soviet Union. There he won the bronze medal in the light middleweight division, after being defeated in the semifinals by eventual silver medalist Aleksandr Koshkyn of the USSR.
